yamlCheck.dateAnchor: November 30 (last day of November), December 1, December 2 and December 4 are independently narrated; the year 1748 comes only from YAML. The opening middle-of-night encounter precedes the one-a.m. camp scene and November 30 breakfast.
yamlCheck.explanation: The source explicitly accounts for four civil-date transitions from November 30 through December 4. YAML starts November 29; that can denote the overnight begun before the opening continuation, but this transcript does not establish the pre-midnight portion as played here. No missing day is supplied from drEnd and no contradiction is established.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The opening continues an overnight encounter; its pre-midnight start is outside the established current-session span.

alternatives.reading: YAML November 29 labels the night begun before midnight; its continued fight and return at one a.m. fall on November 30.
A civil-date boundary based on the recorded post-midnight events begins November 30, conditional on the subsequent November 30 breakfast anchor.
